topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: Just got the news about the place I’ve been going to for years, the one with the best pasta in town, and it’s shutting down. They had a special way of making the alfredo that just couldn’t be beat. I remember the times I spent there, catching up with friends, celebrating birthdays. It’s hard to imagine the corner won’t glow the same once it’s gone. I guess I’ll have to find a new spot, but it won’t be the same. Maybe I’ll try to recreate that dish at home, but it won’t taste quite right without the memory of walking in and seeing everything just as it was.
